data.claim: Identifier-shaped tokens (snake_case, camelCase, --flags) removed by a diff, absent from every non-doc file and tracked path afterwards, and still present in doc files, are real stale mentions; replayed over this repo's history the noise is low
data.falsifier: replay yields mostly false positives, or no true positive at all
data.mechanism: per-commit -U0 diff, removed-minus-added token set, liveness via git grep --cached line output re-matched in Python, then git grep over doc globs
data.probe: replay over 110 non-merge commits: 190 removed tokens, 113 gone from code, 3 doc hits
data.probe_output: 3 hits, all true: ARCHITECTURE.md:39,42 say sort order (lamport, agent_id, event_id) but events.py:130 sort_key is (lamport, agent, id); RESEARCH.md:618 cites test_the_package_has_no_runtime_dependencies, deleted in 48aae97. Side finding: git grep -o with many -F patterns undercounts (agent_id: 19 via -o vs present in many files via -c), so liveness must re-match whole lines, not trust -o. data.summary: docsync.parse_diff treats hunk content starting '--- '/'+++ ' (a removed '-- ' SQL comment, an added '++ ' line) as a file header: the removed line's tokens are dropped and the doc/code state flips mid-file (rubber-duck, CONFIRMED)

evidence.note: refute-prompted Sonnet: 2 CONFIRMED (header/content collision in parse_diff, both reproduced) -> bug B6ef19d337f fixed in 6257693 with 2 mutation-verified regression tests; glob translator, hook chaining, rename/binary/mode diffs held

data.summary: docsync default doc_globs include **/*.txt, so CMakeLists.txt / requirements.txt count as docs: a name removed from them is never a code removal (bug hunt on B17)

evidence.note: Bounded hunt over docsync/check_docs: rubber-duck's header collision fixed (B6ef19d337f); own hunt found *.txt misclassifying build files (B8ed86b84bf, fixed, probe fails on old default).
